name: Snooty Booty
source:
This elegant aristo-cat is used to a lavish lifestyle. She likes a good skincare routine, a shady spot to take a nap, and being pampered.
Age: 11 years and 6 months 
Breed: Sphynx 
Will you give her the TLC she demands?
